description: For a selected input \(a\), the selected-successor guarded graph has exactly one output exactly when \(P(s(a))\) holds.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.InterpretingTheories.successor_graph_condition.{u, v, w} {K : FirstOrder.Language} (P : K.Relations 1)
  (s : K.Functions 1) {M : Type w} [K.Structure M]
  (a : (Lemmatheca.Entry.InterpretingTheories.successorData P s).Domain M) :
  (∃! y,
      ((Lemmatheca.Entry.InterpretingTheories.successorData P s).guardedGraph { down := ⋯ }).Realize
        (Sum.elim (fun x => ↑a) fun x => y)) ↔
    FirstOrder.Language.Structure.RelMap P fun x => FirstOrder.Language.Structure.funMap s fun x => ↑a
